text:
josh_pm: Heads-up — Customer A ran into a migration blocker: their integrations rely on v1 tool-calling semantics (explicit `tools` array + `call_id`) and our v2 route changes the `function_call` flow. They want a compatibility plan before we flip the switch.

anne_product: Can we scope a compatibility shim? we should list must-have behaviors for GA: 1) no silent failures for tool calls, 2) 1:1 mapping of tool metadata, 3) telemetry to show migrated traffic.

sam_engineering: Quick reality check: a full 1:1 runtime compatibility is nontrivial — v2 streamlines steps (we implicit-route to kernels, different response envelope). But we can build a translation layer at the API gateway that rewrites v1 payloads to v2 and maps responses back.

josh_pm: Good. Define launch criteria then. I'm thinking: migration shim available, docs & sample snippets, opt-in beta, and at least two customers migrated successfully.

anne_product: Also add non-goal: we won't support old bespoke `call_id` semantics that depend on external state. customers must either use stateless tool calls or adopt our adapter example.

sam_engineering: Implementation notes: adapter will need to: 1) accept `tools` array + `call_id` from v1, 2) call v2 model with `tool_registry_ref`, 3) capture v2 `callbacks` and emit a v1-style event stream. Rough sketch:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v2-chat",
  "function_call": {"name":"invoke"},
  "tool_registry_ref": "customer.tools.v1"
}
```

maria_sre: Observability reqs: we need per-route metrics for mismatched responses, error-rate by adapter, latency P50/P95 delta vs native v2, and a migration dashboard. Also set an alert if adapter error-rate > 1% for 10m.

josh_pm: Timeline proposal: 2 weeks spec + docs, 3 weeks adapter dev + tests, 1 week canary with 10% traffic, 3 months soft-deprecation notice to customers on opt-in, final cut 6 months after GA unless opt-outs exist. Thoughts?

anne_product: Sounds reasonable. Add acceptance criteria: sample integrations (node/python) that show no code change for customers, and an eval harness proving parity for top 5 customer prompts.

sam_engineering: Dev caveat: we need explicit mapping table for response fields. I'll create a draft PR with the mapping and a minimal adapter prototype. ETA: end of next week.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued — job id deploy-2026-03-20-817. Status: queued.

maria_sre: One more: include a migration playbook section: how to enable debug logs, how to rollback to v1 route, and contact points for high-priority customers.

josh_pm: I'll draft the playbook (customer-facing steps + internal runbook) and assign owners: @sam_engineering for adapter, @maria_sre for observability, @anne_product for docs & comms. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

anne_product: I'll make a short checklist PR in the product repo and ping legal for messaging review.

sam_engineering: ping me if any customers need custom adapters; we can evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

josh_pm: Closing loop: we aim for a beta toggle in 6 weeks and public GA in ~3 months assuming no major blockers. Keep updates here.
